description: Source code for a VSCode extension class implementing IDE functionalities, including file operations, editor interactions, and language feature integrations.

classes.name: VsCodeIde
classes.description: A class implementing IDE interface for VSCode, providing file management, editor interaction, and language feature support.

methods.name: getIdeInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the IDE, such as type.

methods.name: getClipboardContent
methods.description: Retrieves current clipboard text and timestamp.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the IDE instance.

methods.name: getWorkspaceDirs
methods.description: Returns list of workspace directory URIs.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given URI.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes contents to a specified file path.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the currently open file in the editor.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads contents of a file, including notebooks and open documents.

methods.name: readRangeInFile
methods.description: Reads a specific range of lines from a file.

methods.name: getOpenFiles
methods.description: Returns list of open file URIs.

methods.name: getCurrentFile
methods.description: Returns info about the currently active file.

methods.name: getFileStats
methods.description: Retrieves last modified time and size for a list of files.

methods.name: gotoDefinition
methods.description: Finds definition locations for a symbol.

methods.name: gotoTypeDefinition
methods.description: Finds type definition locations for a symbol.

methods.name: getSignatureHelp
methods.description: Provides signature help at a location.

methods.name: onDidChangeActiveTextEditor
methods.description: Registers callback for active editor change events.
